verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other RAG/agent-framework integration for Milvus. The MCP server tutorial belongs to a separate MCP story and does not count here, and the pymilvus SDK and Milvus Lite are general client libraries, not maintained framework integrations.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can plug the database into RAG and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.) through maintained first-class integrations
